The '''Tourist Center''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was a building located near the [[Senate Landing Platform]] where the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Naboo Royal Starship]] arrived in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It was the headquarters of [[Coruscant City Tours]] and location of the [[Tourist Director]]'s office. Beings could purchase tickets from a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] to embark on the Tours on the [[tour transport]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Tourist Center appears in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]].
